name: Lewatit VP OC 1065, Young 2021 temperature-advisory humid extrapolation

evidence.basis: The unchanged Young 2021 Toth, GAB, LDF-rate and process-heat values are evaluated with IAPWS local saturation in a named exploratory scenario. Actual temperatures are recorded; the requested 116 C value and former 20-120 C range are not hard validity boundaries. Genuine equation-domain branches remain enforced.
evidence.not_for: validated equilibrium or coupling outside 25-70 C, measured humid-cycle accuracy, validated hot-vacuum rates or energy transfer, equipment suitability, cyclic steady state, lifetime, degradation trigger, or annual production.

shaped_material.basis: The app case supplies a dry shaped resin mass; the source measured resin sample is not a shaped device.
shaped_material.binder_support: Commercial resin beads are represented as the dry resin solid; no binder or support is added.
shaped_material.particle_geometry: The case particle diameter remains a transfer assumption.

temperature_advisory.statement: Record actual accepted and solver-query temperatures; crossing 116 C or the former 20-120 C range alone does not terminate this scenario.

historical_evaluation_range.classification: historical discretionary range retained for comparison only; not enforced

co2.source_locator: Young et al. 2021 DOI 10.1039/D1EE01272J Tables 2 and 4; process heat from SI Table S9

water.source_locator: Young et al. 2021 DOI 10.1039/D1EE01272J equations 5-8 and 25-26; process heat from SI Table S9
water.basis: Unchanged Young GAB coefficients evaluated from local H2O partial pressure and IAPWS saturation. No cross-specimen correction is fitted.

water_evaluation_policy.storage_scale_basis: Numerical scaling only; no experimental or physical upper-bound claim.
water_evaluation_policy.negative_residual_normalization_scope: CO2-helper evaluation only; raw ODE inventory, deltas, energy and exports remain unchanged

kinetics.evidence_status: Unchanged Young 2021 SI Table S9 process constants. Humid, hot and vacuum transfer rates remain assumptions outside measured support.

equilibrium.class: unchanged source-reproduced Young fit outside its measured coupled support

measured_constraint.status: not spliced into the Young coefficients

adsorbed_energy.basis: Constant CP_GAS and 70/46 kJ/mol process heats preserve the original convention.

assumptions: Measured Young coupled support remains 25-70 C and RH 0-0.55.
Temperatures outside measured support are exploratory extrapolation, including local transient excursions.
The requested 116 C regeneration target and the previous 20-120 C evaluation range are advisory and are not hard stops.
No temperature ceiling or state-temperature clamp is introduced; actual temperatures remain in accepted states, histories and exports.
The local water branch uses H2O partial pressure divided by IAPWS saturation pressure and requires an unsaturated finite branch.
The actual evolving stored-water inventory drives the unchanged Young WADST CO2 target.
Only a negative water residual within 1e-9 mol/kg may be normalized at the CO2-helper boundary; the raw state, delta and energy remain unchanged.
Hot binary coupling, adsorption/desorption rates and energy transfer are unvalidated transfers.
Wilkins 110 C and Low 2023 measurements are diagnostic constraints, not fitted corrections or same-specimen validation.

validity.equilibrium: Measured coupled support ends at 25-70 C; values outside it are exploratory extrapolation with no accuracy claim.
validity.water: Local IAPWS unsaturated branches are evaluated without a 0.55 RH cap; departure from the measured support is reported.
validity.cycle: Numerical scenario only; rates, caloric closure, drainage and thermal lag are unvalidated.
validity.initial_state_interpretation: Equilibrated initialization is a numerical scenario state, not cyclic steady state.

uncertainty.statement: Finite exploratory output is not a validated prediction outside the measured 25-70 C support. The absence of an arbitrary stop does not imply material stability or accuracy.
